entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohamed Medbouh was a senior Moroccan Army officer. He was Minister of Posts, Telegraphs and Telephones in the government of Abdallah Ibrahim (1958–1960). He was co-organizer with Colonel M'hamed Ababou of the coup against his brother-in-law King Hassan II of Morocco of 10 July 1971.
